description: Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan for Individual for Non BPL whose family income should be at least 2lakhs per annum.

name: Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana
description: Under this scheme, a monthly financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to full-time accredited journalists who are 60 years of age or older & have served continuously for at least 20 years in daily, weekly, fortnightly newspapers, independent publications, electronic media,…

name: Rajiv Gandhi Krishak Sathi Sahayta Yojana
description: The Rajiv Gandhi Krishak Sathi Sahayta Yojana offers financial support to farmers, farmworkers, and market laborers who are accidentally injured or killed while working in agriculture or at agricultural markets.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship For Academic Excellence
description: In order to provide financial assistance to meritorious students of Rajasthan to study in top foreign universities of the world. The scheme commenced from 5th October 2021.

name: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana
description: Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer.

name: Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates
description: The scheme aims to support the Scheduled Tribe candidates from Scheduled Areas and the Saharia Area of Rajasthan to register themselves as research scholars with all recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University located in any part of India for pursuing Ph.D. Programme.

name: Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs
description: The scheme aims to provide lifelong financial assistance of ₹5,000/- per month to war widows and parents of unmarried martyrs who sacrificed their lives in various wars, counter-insurgency operations, and aid to civil authorities before 31st March 1999.

name: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
description: In the year 1998, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of Schedule Cast.

name: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
description: In the year 1984, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of the Schedule Tribe.

name: Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee
description: As per the MSME Policy 2024, it supports the establishment of new MSMEs and the expansion, diversification, or modernization of existing ones by offering interest subsidies and reimbursement of guarantee fees to ease access to finance and reduce the cost of credit.

name: Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to MSMEs participating in national and international fairs/exhibitions/buyer-seller meets, etc., under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024.

name: Scheme For Study In Abroad
description: In the year 2010-11, Rajasthan Government has taken the initiative to encourage girl child education by starting a scheme to Study Abroad.

name: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
description: Under this scheme, a scholarship of ₹15,000 per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemen, from the rank of Sepoy to Havildar, who are pursuing vocational & technical education & have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or…

name: Shednet House
description: The Shednet House provided subsidies to farmers so they could earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetables, flowers, fruits, etc. by controlling the agro-climatic factors, temperature, humidity, and sunlight.

name: Shubhshakti Yojana
description: The Shubshakti Yojana has been initiated by the Rajasthan government with the aim of providing financial assistance to regular construction workers, unmarried laborers, and their daughters.

name: Silicosis Pidit Hita-dhikariyon Hetu Sahayata Yojana
description: The Silicosis Affected Workers Welfare Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to workers suffering from silicosis and their families.

name: Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram
description: In "Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram" Rajasthan government will provide subsidies to farmers on purchasing irrigation pipelines. So that farmers can get rid of the problem of irrigation. And their income can increase.

name: Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan
description: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per…

name: Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana
description: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Suraksha Laghu Evan Seemaant Vrddhajan Krshak Sammaan Penshan Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives by providing them with monthly financial assistance.

name: Technology Acquisition Assistance
description: The scheme aims to support Micro and Small enterprises in state to acquire advanced technology/ software related to their production/ manufacturing processes through assistance towards cost incurred for technology/ software acquisition.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students
description: The scheme aims to promote higher and technical education among transgender individuals by providing financial assistance for their educational expenses. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a refund of their school, college, higher, or technical education fees.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Financial Assistance for Studying Bisexual Children
description: The scheme objective is to provide financial assistance of ₹6,000 per month for up to 12 months to transgender students from Class 6 and above for accommodation and daily needs if they live away from their homes for education.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Post Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
description: The scheme aims to support transgender students pursuing post-matric education. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to cover educational expenses for their post-matric studies.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Pre Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
description: The scheme aims to support transgender students by providing scholarships to encourage their education and social upliftment. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹225/- per month to cover educational expenses from primary to pre-matric levels.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Self Employment Programme for Transgender
description: The scheme objective is to provide financial assistance to transgender individuals for self-employment/business establishment. Eligible beneficiaries can receive up to ₹50,000/- or 25% of the project cost.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Training Programme for Transgender
description: The scheme aims to support the socio-economic development of transgender individuals by providing financial assistance, skill training, and employment opportunities.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh – Identity Card for Transgender
description: This scheme aims to identify transgender persons and issuing identity cards to them. This certificate/identity card will be valid for all government purposes, including obtaining a ration card, Aadhaar card, birth certificate, etc.

name: Urdu Scholarship- Rajasthan
description: The scheme aims to promote the Urdu language among female students at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Under this scheme, a monthly scholarship is provided to undergraduate and postgraduate students who are studying Urdu as an optional subject.

name: Vadh Se Bachaye Govansh Ko Sahayata Yojana
description: The "Vadh Se Bachaye Govansh Ko Sahayata Yojana" scheme, initiated by the Directorate of Gopalan on 02/07/2015, provides financial assistance for the care and maintenance of cattle rescued from illegal slaughter or smuggling.

name: Vermicompost Ikai
description: In the Vermicompost Ikai scheme, provide subsidies to farmers and Organic fertilizer is a systematic pest-nutrition process in which the soil is made fertile by absorbing other organic substances present within the soil.

name: Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana
description: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives of widow women.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana
description: Under this scheme, scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement are provided to specially-abled students belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2.00 lakh, who are regularly studying in government and recognized educational institutions.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana
description: Under this scheme, children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistance, the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals to support a happy married life after marriage. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided.

name: Walk In Tunnel
description: Under the Walk-In Tunnel, the Rajasthan government provides the benefit of a subsidy to the farmers with affordable and efficient structures that offer protection from adverse weather conditions, pests, and diseases.

name: Widow B.Ed Scheme-Rajasthan
description: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Widow B.Ed Scheme" for Widow/abandoned women.

name: World War II Pension
description: The aim of the scheme is to provide lifelong financial assistance of ₹15,000/- per month as a measure of relief to World War II ex-servicemen and their widows who are not receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source.

name: Young Interns Program
description: The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship program, envisaged by the Government of Rajasthan, for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programs, schemes and projects of the government…

name: Zero Budget Natural Farming
description: The Rajasthan State government started a scheme "Zero Budget Natual Farming" in 2020-21 to promote natural farming.
